title: Medicare Advantage Health Plans: Plan Premium, Billing Cadence and Premium Day Counts by Plan
content:
Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plans carry the plan premium figures and premium-related day counts set out below. Each figure is the figure of the plan the member holds, and no figure of one plan is read against another.

| Plan | Monthly plan premium (USD) | Default billing cadence | Premium due day of the coverage month | Grace period (calendar days) | Reinstatement window (calendar days) | Part B premium reduction (USD per month) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 0.00 | monthly | 5 | 90 | 60 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 0.00 | monthly | 5 | 90 | 60 | 25.00 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 18.40 | monthly | 5 | 90 | 60 | 50.00 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 47.60 | monthly | 1 | 90 | 60 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 89.30 | quarterly | 1 | 120 | 90 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 134.70 | quarterly | 1 | 120 | 90 | 0.00 |

### What each column carries

1. **Monthly plan premium.** The plan premium billed to the member for each coverage month, in USD.
2. **Default billing cadence.** The billing cadence assigned to the enrollment at election, either monthly or quarterly.
3. **Premium due day of the coverage month.** The calendar day of the coverage month on which the plan premium falls due, taken as a day of the month between 1 and 28.
4. **Grace period.** The calendar days running after the first unpaid premium charge before an involuntary termination may be processed.
5. **Reinstatement window.** The calendar days running after the coverage end date within which a good-cause reinstatement may still be asked for.
6. **Part B premium reduction.** The monthly reduction in the member's Part B premium credited through Social Security, in USD.

### Reading the schedule

The two plans whose default cadence is quarterly, Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) and Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO), are also the two carrying the longer grace period of 120 calendar days and the longer reinstatement window of 90 calendar days; the four plans billed monthly carry 90 and 60 calendar days respectively. Two plans carry a Part B premium reduction: Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) at 25.00 USD a month and Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) at 50.00 USD a month. Two plans, Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) and Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO), carry no monthly plan premium at all, their figure being 0.00 USD.
